actual: BUG-982 source PR #3159 changes only offline HMM diagnostic files and correctly classifies runtime_impact=none, but close-sync reclassifies the registered allowed scope including unmodified stock_fact_repository.py as backend runtime and blocks on nonexistent restart/runbook/fresh-process requirements. Close-sync must derive runtime impact from the merged PR changed files and fail closed if that evidence cannot be obtained; it must not use unmodified allowed scope as actual changes.
